_readme: 通用模板（12 帧视频路线，v2.1.0）。本文件不是一套固定表情包：只含 3 条格式示例（01 打招呼、02 谢谢、03 欢迎），其余 21 条是占位，由使用者自己填满 24 条。形象与表情都由使用者自定——先跑 prepare_character.py 用自己的形象图生成形象基准卡，再把本文件复制为项目 entries.json，逐条替换 text/name/meaning/frames/prop_spec/face。frames 必须是正好 12 条英文动作描述，按 C1–C12 十二帧格式：C1 站立起势；C2–C4 展开蓄势；C5–C9 峰值区——核心姿态保持不换，靠表情/重心/头歪/眨眼/道具微动填充；C10–C11 回落；C12 回到 C1，保证 loop=0 循环不跳。每格至少 3 个部位相对上一格变化。禁用“六格同站姿、只有脸动”；手势类条目要突出手势本身。composition: full|half|scene；motion: dramatic|state。

entries.name: 打招呼
entries.meaning: 挥手问好
entries.face: Bright cheerful smile growing across the frames; eyes widen then curve into crescents in the peak zone (frames 5-9); brows rise with the wave.
frames: NARROW UPRIGHT, ARMS DOWN: standing straight, both arms at the sides, head level, eyes forward.
RIGHT ARM RISING: right arm lifts to shoulder height, palm open, head turns slightly right, weight shifts to the left foot.
WAVE START: right hand rises above the shoulder, palm facing out, fingers spread, left arm stays at the side, torso turns a touch.
BUILD TO PEAK: right hand at its highest, waving, elbow bent, head tilts left, right foot steps out.
PEAK — BIG WAVE: right hand waves widest, arm fully raised, head tilted most, biggest smile, left hand on the hip.
PEAK HOLD: same pose as FRAME 5; the wave continues, eyes curve into crescents.
PEAK HOLD: same pose as FRAME 5; head tilts a little further, a blink lands.
PEAK HOLD: same pose as FRAME 5; weight shifts, the waving hand moves a fraction lower.
PEAK HOLD: same pose as FRAME 5 at its strongest; the biggest smile of the set, then the hold releases.
LOWER AND STRAIGHTEN: right arm dropping to chest height, head returning to center, smile softening.
HALF RETREAT: right arm nearly down, torso straight, eyes forward.
SLOW RETURN: standing straight again, both arms at the sides, matching frame 1 so the loop closes.

entries.name: 谢谢
entries.meaning: 感谢
entries.face: Gentle grateful smile; eyes soften and close briefly in the peak zone (frames 5-9); brows relax.
frames: NARROW UPRIGHT, ARMS DOWN: standing straight, both arms at the sides, head level, eyes forward.
HANDS RISING: both hands lift toward the chest, palms facing each other, head lowers slightly.
PALMS TOGETHER: both palms press together in front of the chest, elbows out, eyes gentle.
BUILD TO PEAK: palms pressed tighter, head bows a touch deeper, shoulders relax.
PEAK — GRATEFUL BOW: palms together at their highest, head bowed most, eyes closed in a warm smile, torso still upright.
PEAK HOLD: same pose as FRAME 5; the smile deepens one notch.
PEAK HOLD: same pose as FRAME 5; head lifts a fraction, eyes open, still smiling.
PEAK HOLD: same pose as FRAME 5; a small nod lands.
PEAK HOLD: same pose as FRAME 5 at its warmest; the biggest gentle smile, then the hold releases.
HANDS LOWERING: palms parting, hands dropping to waist height, head rising.
HALF RETREAT: hands nearly at the sides, torso straight, eyes forward.
SLOW RETURN: standing straight again, both arms at the sides, matching frame 1 so the loop closes.

entries.name: 欢迎
entries.meaning: 热情迎接
entries.face: Warm welcoming smile growing across the frames; eyes widen then curve into crescents in the peak zone (frames 5-9); brows rise.
frames: NARROW UPRIGHT, ARMS DOWN: standing straight, both arms at the sides, head level, eyes forward.
ARMS RISING: both arms lift out to the sides, palms open, head lifts, eyes brighten.
ARMS OPENING WIDE: both arms spread wide to the sides, chest open, torso straight, warm smile.
BUILD TO PEAK: arms opening widest, shoulders back, head tilts slightly, smile grows.
PEAK — WIDE OPEN WELCOME: both arms spread widest in a big V, chest out, head tilted most, biggest smile, eyes curve into crescents.
PEAK HOLD: same pose as FRAME 5; the open arms hold, eyes curve.
PEAK HOLD: same pose as FRAME 5; head tilts a little further, a blink lands.
PEAK HOLD: same pose as FRAME 5; weight shifts, the open arms move a fraction.
PEAK HOLD: same pose as FRAME 5 at its warmest; the biggest smile of the set, then the hold releases.
ARMS LOWERING: both arms dropping to shoulder height, smile softening, head returning to center.
HALF RETREAT: arms nearly at the sides, torso straight, eyes forward.
SLOW RETURN: standing straight again, both arms at the sides, matching frame 1 so the loop closes.
